The lecture notes for the first part of ENGI 1111, Thermodynamics and Fluid
Mechanics I: the course syllabus and all six chapters, in one document.

| | Online | PDF |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **Notes with gaps**: the version used in the lectures | [open](notes.qmd) | [download](pdf/notes-with-gaps.pdf) |
| **Completed notes**: everything filled in, with worked solutions | [open](notes-complete.qmd) | [download](pdf/notes-complete.pdf) |

**In the notes with gaps**, the steps of each derivation and the solution of each
example are covered. In the lecture we uncover them one at a time: space or
the arrow keys move through the gaps and **P** switches to presentation mode;
to see everything at once, use the completed notes. The worked solution of each end-of-chapter problem
stays covered until you click it, so try the problem first.

**Questions during the lecture?** Ask them anonymously at
[{{< meta qa-url >}}]({{< meta qa-url >}}), or with the **Ask a question**
button on the notes with gaps.

**The PDF with gaps** leaves the same gaps blank, and a page for your working
after each end-of-chapter problem: print it and bring it to the lecture.
